title: Rethinking Relative Policy Differences Transfer of On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.13205v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a target policy on its own rollouts using token-level supervision from a stronger teacher, but typically relies on the teacher being substantially more capable than the target. Recent work relaxes this requirement by transferring the relative policy difference between an expert and a reference policy rather than the expert's absolute distribution. Yet it remains unclear which differences provide useful supervision and which targets can benefit from them. We develop a unified view in which the log-probability ratio between a proxy expert and a proxy reference defines an implicit reward for KL-regularized policy optimization. This formulation induces an on-policy update for the target, recovers conventional OPD as a special case, and enables any-to-any transfer across models that differ in scale, training stage or generation. translated_title: 重新思考在线策略蒸馏中的相对策略差异迁移
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）利用来自更强教师模型的 token 级监督，在目标策略自身生成的 rollout 上对其进行训练，但通常依赖于教师模型显著强于目标模型这一前提。最近的工作通过迁移专家模型与参考策略之间的相对策略差异、而非专家模型的绝对分布，放宽了这一要求。然而，究竟哪些差异能提供有用的监督信号，以及哪些目标模型能够从中受益，仍不清楚。我们提出了一个统一的视角：代理专家与代理参考模型之间的对数概率比率定义了 KL 正则化策略优化的一种隐式奖励。这一表述为目标策略带来了在线策略更新，将传统 OPD 恢复为特例，并实现了在不同规模、训练阶段或代际的模型之间的任意到任意迁移。我们的系统性实验得出了三个发现。首先，更强的专家不再……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一框架，将专家与参考策略之间的相对策略差异视为 KL 正则化策略优化的隐式奖励，从而突破了教师必须显著强于目标模型的限制，实现不同规模、训练阶段和代际模型之间的任意到任意在线策略蒸馏迁移。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified framework that treats the relative policy difference between an expert and a reference policy as an implicit reward for KL-regularized policy optimization, removing the requirement that the teacher be substantially stronger than the target and enabling any-to-any transfer of on-policy distillation across models of different scales, training stages, and generations.
